text: 日本国内市场鸡蛋价格近日再创新高，且由于禽流感季来临和新年前后消费旺季将至，蛋价预计可能继续高企。日本农林水产省本月19日至21日的全国范围调查结果显示，每盒10个装鸡蛋平均价格为312日元（约合13.2元人民币），比9月上涨3日元，为2003年开始这项调查以来新高。另外，鸡腿肉和进口牛肉的价格也与最高纪录持平。（新华社）
text_en: Egg prices in Japan's domestic market recently hit a new record high, and due to the arrival of the avian influenza season and the upcoming peak consumption period around the New Year, egg prices are expected to remain high. A nationwide survey by Japan's Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries from the 19th to the 21st of this month showed that the average price of a pack of 10 eggs was 312 yen (about 13.2 yuan), up 3 yen from September and a record high since the survey began in 2003. In addition, prices of chicken thigh meat and imported beef were also tied with record highs. (Xinhua News Agency)
